companies.name: Lionheart Capital
companies.quote: Ophir Sternberg is the Founder & CEO of Lionheart Capital and has been involved in the acquisition and development of several properties, including The Ritz-Carlton Residences in Miami Beach, as well as The Seagull Hotel in Miami Beach.

companies.name: Out of the Box Ventures
companies.quote: Mr. Sternberg is also the Founder & CEO of Out of the Box Ventures, a company specializing in repositioning distressed retail properties throughout the United States.
